lines.text: There he goes.
Do you really think that there's a key here, Bola?
Bola?
Hey, Bola, where are you?!
Did you say something, Klaymoor?
...Did you say something, Klaymoor?
Get with it, Bola.
We might be the ones to find the Mother Lode.
Doesn't that mean anything to you?
No, not at all.
Why should I care?
I've got enough money to keep me living the good life for a long time.
I want out of this game.
Get it, Klaymoor?
Come on, Bola, don't say that.
I've dreamed of finding the Mother Lode for years.
Help me out, huh?
I'll let you take care of that blue kid.
I'm going to check out another island.
Alright, alright... Wouldn't want to get in the way of you and your treasure.
